topic: Acer Chromebook black screen or display glitching
record_type: new tips page (topic queue item 20, built on Sam's yes Nov 23)
uniqueness: First Chromebook-specific guide. Distinct from /tips/laptop-screen-black-but-running (Windows shortcuts) and /tips/laptop-screen-damaged-after-drop: ChromeOS brightness key, Refresh + Power hard reset, Ctrl + Show windows screenshot test, Ctrl + Shift + 0, external display test, and why Powerwash or recovery can't fix a panel or cable.
bench_point: None added. No invented bench stories, stats or prices.
scope: Hardware triage (screen, backlight, display cable, hinge) with ChromeOS-specific safe checks. Counts toward the 80% hardware mix.

sources.used_for: Hard reset steps (Refresh + tap Power, release Refresh on startup); may delete some Downloads files; admins can block blank-screen bypass
Ctrl + Show windows screenshot; Ctrl + Shift + 0 resets screen resolution
Refresh + Power ~10 s variant; sun brightness key; charging light; external monitor; Powerwash file-loss warning
Brightness knocked to zero; disconnect external devices; let it cool; external monitor test
Cause list: charger, external display detected, defective display, faulty display cable, pinhole reset on some models
Recovery erases data stored on the device

integration: sitemap.xml new url; lastmod bumped for tips, guides, laptop-repair, tips/laptop-problems
limits: Acer and Google describe the hard reset slightly differently; both given. Model-label naming not stated. Measure clicks about four weeks after publishing.
